local_inspection_failures: A stale execution-session poll after interruption had no remaining session.
A literal Windows wildcard path passed to rg produced OS error 123; retried with directory and -g.
Guessed repair_v2.py and repair_v3.py paths did not exist; found freeze_repair_v2.py and freeze_repair.py with scoped search.
release/code/verify_benchmarks.py was absent; available score_benchmark.py and score_core.py were inspected instead.
First impact run encountered list-valued chart-location dictionaries; parser extended and rerun.
First prose-record verification assumed UTF-8, but PowerShell Tee-Object wrote UTF-16; checker now handles the byte-order mark.
Follow-up first writing-rule read used the owned-directory-relative path; corrected to repository root.
First versioned impact invocation used relative input paths that failed pinning; argument paths now resolve before joins.
